{"text":"# T-46 · A-SENSING — Shared pulse, contact and echo assets
Project: MIT ECCO
Doer: Codex sub-agent / master delegated
Reviewer: Radzi

## Outcome
Reusable T43-directed acoustic event package bound to actual ECCO sensors and T44 wall geometry, with clear cyan send/contact/emerald return and an event/measurement interface for later graphics and cased response. Extract useful B201 work; no full reconstruction/output package or movie shots.

## Completion criteria
- Read live handoff, AGENTS.md, T42 register, T43 controlling amendment/contracts and accepted T44 masters; inspect actual native sources before building.
- Follow T43 and the AI Director/Directorial Identity. Mechanical boards supply facts, not camera direction. Escalate consequential visual choices to the director/Radzi.
- Work only in master-assigned paths. Link accepted T44 hardware/environment; preserve dimensions, sensor references and originals. Do not edit another worker's files.
- Publish versioned shared masters, stable controls and a manifest with source hashes, units/axes, dependencies, limits and relevant V3 consumer IDs.
- Demonstrate reuse in two lightweight linked consumers. Propagate one bounded shared revision while retaining each consumer's camera/timing; fresh-open and check links.
- Provide individual camera-framed approval stills and a short playable behavior demo from saved candidates. Inspect actual images/motion; checklists alone do not prove appearance.
- Coordinate every render through the master queue. Benchmark representative/peak states <5s/frame before batches; retain failures, settings and the known cold-cache limitation.
- Save masters under 04-Production/Shared/Assets and evidence under Records/Tasks/T-<number>. Keep heavy native/video media local with exact paths and backup status.
- Master alone integrates Git changes. Supply task-owned changes; verify committed/pushed permitted evidence and attach pinned report/candidate plus local media paths before Review.
- Maintain Work run/heartbeat records; report blockers and repairs to master. Submit for Radzi review; no self-acceptance, actual movie shots or film assembly.
- Implement cyan send and emerald return, three restrained arcs each, local curved cup membrane and fine patch, using T43 VD03 and S02/S04 contracts.
- Bind send/receive to the same actual sensor; contact follows true wall hit/normal. No pulse continues beyond contact. Preserve world-fixed samples during assembly motion.
- Expose event ID, emitter, hit position/normal, send/contact/receive timing, patch lifetime, opacity and visibility; distinguish illustrative timing from real acoustic speed.
- Preserve three sensor references in one plane and 120-degree spacing. Reuse source geometry; do not invent a mud-sensor coordinate.
- Provide minimal sourced/schematic arrival-time cue for the demo and a documented event adapter for A-CASED/A-OUTPUT. Full maps/reconstruction/graphics remain later scope.

## Inputs
- T42 component register: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/e49c9ff8d26466b76e909b515bd9929bbae0d5ab/04-Production/Records/Tasks/T-042/component-register_v001.md
- T42 component consumers: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/e49c9ff8d26466b76e909b515bd9929bbae0d5ab/04-Production/Records/Tasks/T-042/shot-map_v001.json
- T43 shared direction — completion amendment controls earlier proposals: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/f62b319dd49252b7ff18d0948ade0655e919fe8d/04-Production/Records/Tasks/T-043/shared-direction_v001.md
- T43 V3 contract release index: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/f62b319dd49252b7ff18d0948ade0655e919fe8d/04-Production/Records/Tasks/T-043/release-index_v001.md
- Current execution and closure instructions: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- T44 cleanup report — current pinned candidate: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/df1bc5626e820dc3a0b9af286bfcca4ce498d8c0/04-Production/Records/Tasks/T-044/report.md
- Updated master controls and migration: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/df1bc5626e820dc3a0b9af286bfcca4ce498d8c0/04-Production/Shared/Assets/World/README_v003.md
- Exact native paths and hashes: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/df1bc5626e820dc3a0b9af286bfcca4ce498d8c0/04-Production/Shared/Assets/World/manifest_v006.json

## Linked board
None

## Required standards
### Current film production cycle — 18 October 2026 · v1
OWNER-AUTHORIZED CURRENT CYCLE — 18 October 2026. Supersedes earlier mechanical-first, B2 pairing, separate still/animation and editable 3D storyboard gates. T31 is completed. Visual source: ECCO - Cinematic Film Storyboard, board ID 8466dd02-7299-4e68-85fc-f95d0d61931e; V3, 22 shots S01-A through S07-C, seven sequences, 90 seconds. Repository source: 03-Context/02_Storyboard/V3/; board/source mapping: 04-Production/Records/Storyboard-Board-V3/README.md.

Cycle: shared-component planning → shared assets and AI-director execution instructions → actual movie shots using fast renders → Radzi assembles film and handles client feedback → affected shot/shared-asset revisions → delivery. Radzi alone owns film assembly/editing, narration/sound integration and final timeline. Agents deliver individual shots and organized editable sources; no agent film assembly ticket.

Planning/orchestration creates placeholders only for visual instructions. A separate AI directing agent owns visual treatments and shot execution instructions using the V3 board, Scene Director skill and Directorial Identity. Blender executes approved instructions. Mechanical boards remain engineering information references.

Shared assets must have canonical masters, stable controls, source/version records, relative links and a shot-consumer map. Decide hardware/BHA/bit, environment, pulse/contact/echo and graphic treatment consistently before dependent shot builds. Reuse verified existing work; do not assume historical acceptance covers new uses. A shared revision propagates through references, then affected shots are checked/rerendered.

Current shot-production render budget: STRICTLY LESS THAN 5 SECONDS PER FRAME on the executing machine at the chosen working settings. Benchmark representative and heaviest frames before batch rendering; record settings and timings. Reduce cost if the limit fails; do not silently raise the cap. This is fast-render actual movie production, not expensive final rendering. Any later expensive delivery-render stage requires a separate owner decision.

Preserve engineering/client constraints, provenance and useful prior evidence. No invented technical approval. Save under 04-Production; masters in Shared/Assets; use V3 shot IDs and map historical IDs explicitly. Commit/push permitted tracked records/scripts/config/evidence, verify remote, attach exact report/commit and local media paths. Heavy/restricted media exclusions remain. Only Radzi accepts results. Only one planning ticket is created now; propose later build/directing/shot tickets after inventory, do not create or execute them automatically.
V3 storyboard board handoff and source map: https://github.com/radz2291/Project-MIT-Ecco/blob/c4f882e971b316656ac7b9dbeb961908f6238620/04-Production/Records/Storyboard-Board-V3/README.md

## Dependencies
T-44 A-WORLD — Shared hardware/environment and revision propagation · done
T-43 D-FILM — Shared visual decisions and V3 shot instructions · done

## Return
Record outputs and a concise result summary on this ticket. Submit for review when a reviewer is assigned. Do not mark reviewed work done on the reviewer's behalf."}
